changelog:
- Input parameters changed: now requires audio_url and optionally dialogue, replacing the previous dialogue_list.
- Output updated: now returns a subtitle_url linking to the generated SRT file, instead of srt_content.
- Skill description and use cases updated to emphasize automatic subtitle generation from audio.
- Technical details clarified: continues to run fully locally without API or model setup.
- Internal metadata file (_meta.json) removed.
summary: Generate synced SRT subtitles locally from dialogue text and durations without API, ensuring platform-compatible timed captions for videos.
